styleSelection.reason: Pure watercolor: broad transparent value planes carry the ship, with soft selected turns and dry, compact paint accents. The reference has no ink structure.

families.referenceCue: The large cool sail and vessel plane curves down the centre into the dark lower hull; keep it broad, chromatic and continuous, with only its turning edge softened.
Pale overlapping sail and warm paper shapes sit behind the blue plane; preserve their near-paper value and lose selected edges into the sheet.
The cropped boat, ochre spars and rigging cluster at the left; group the dark overlap as one connected mass and keep warm marks sparse.
A soft turquoise water band opens at the right; make one connected light passage, then add only a few broken reflections after drying.
